name: analytics-demo-product
title: Product analytics demo data
description: Demo data, loader and live update for the SheenUI product analytics dashboard. Not needed in production.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Product analytics demo data: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/dashboards/product

Installed in components/sheenui/blocks/analytics/. Import (use your components alias):
import { productDemoData, productDemoLoader, productLiveStep } from "@/components/sheenui/blocks/analytics/demo-product";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
